description: Source code for a Linux kernel GPIO Button Hotplug driver, managing GPIO-based button events, including handling of interrupts, polling, and uevent notifications.

methods.name: bh_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a formatted variable string to a uevent skb buffer.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills a uevent with button event variables.

methods.name: button_hotplug_work
methods.description: Handles the work of broadcasting a button hotplug event.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button hotplug event.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button_map array.

methods.name: gpio_button_get_value
methods.description: Reads the current value of a GPIO button.

methods.name: gpio_keys_handle_button
methods.description: Processes a button state change and generates events.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_queue_work
methods.description: Schedules polling work for GPIO buttons.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_poll
methods.description: Polls GPIO buttons and handles state changes.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_close
methods.description: Stops polling and disables GPIO buttons.

methods.name: gpio_keys_irq_work_func
methods.description: Work function for handling IRQ-based button events.

methods.name: button_handle_irq
methods.description: IRQ handler for GPIO button interrupts with debounce.

methods.name: gpio_keys_get_devtree_pdata
methods.description: Retrieves platform data from device tree.

methods.name: gpio_keys_button_probe
methods.description: Probes and initializes GPIO buttons, setting up GPIOs and IRQs.

methods.name: gpio_keys_probe
methods.description: Main probe function for gpio-keys driver, sets up IRQs.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_probe
methods.description: Probe function for polled GPIO keys driver.

methods.name: gpio_keys_irq_close
methods.description: Disables IRQs and cancels polling work.

methods.name: gpio_keys_remove
methods.description: Removes driver and cleans up resources.

methods.name: gpio_button_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers gpio-keys and gpio-keys-polled drivers.

methods.name: gpio_button_exit
methods.description: Unregisters drivers on module exit.
